title: okf-loop configuration
description: Settings for the okf-loop mod, read from .okf/config.json in the project. Every key is optional: what is missing is filled from the defaults, and a value that does not validate is replaced by its default and reported in the pane (Setup tab). Lists replace the default list, they do not extend it.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor completion and validation. Optional.

knowledge.description: Where the knowledge base (plays, stages, templates) comes from.

root.description: Directory, relative to the repository, holding the project's own openknowledge/ tree. When it exists its plays, stages and templates override the snapshot bundled with the mod, per play number and per template.

autonomy.description: How far the mod may drive the loop on its own. It never passes a human gate, whatever is set here.

mode.description: manual: guards and the ledger only. guided: the mod proposes the next step and a person triggers it. semi: the agent runs every non-human step itself (draft spec, draft plan, implement, verify, review) and stops at the next human gate. semi degrades to guided while Play 04 is disabled.

maxAutoTurns.description: Autopilot turns allowed between two human gates. When the budget is spent the autopilot halts until a person passes a gate or resumes it.

haltOnBlocks.description: Halt the autopilot after this many guard blocks in a row without a good step in between.

haltOnVerifyFails.description: Halt the autopilot after this many failed verifications in a row.

humanGates.description: Gates that need a named person. release.approve is always required and is restored if removed. A gate that is not listed passes on its own once its machine requirements hold; verify.pass and review.pass are machine gates and only need a person if you list them.

autoKinds.description: Next-action kinds the autopilot may run unattended in semi mode. Steps that are for a person (gates, the interview, release) are never run by the autopilot.

plays.description: Which of the 14 plays of openknowledge/INDEX.md are adopted. Each adopted play switches real behaviour on (guards, scaffolds, prompts).

enabled.description: Adopted play numbers. A play needs every prerequisite adopted too (Play 11 needs Play 07, and so on); on load, a play whose prerequisite is not adopted is switched off and reported. A play cannot be disabled while an adopted play depends on it.

paths.description: Where artifacts live. {slug} (the run slug) and {date} (YYYY-MM-DD) expand.

intent.description: Stage 1 artifact (intent.md), one per run. {slug} expands to the run slug. Must be relative to the repository; only {slug} and {date} expand. Must contain {slug}.

spec.description: Stage 2 artifact (spec.md), one per run. Must be relative to the repository; only {slug} and {date} expand. Must contain {slug}.

plan.description: Stage 3 artifact (plan.md), one per run. Source edits wait until its Status is accepted. Must be relative to the repository; only {slug} and {date} expand. Must contain {slug}.

proof.description: Stage 4 verifier report, one per run. It must contain "### Verification Verdict: PASS" or "FAIL". Must be relative to the repository; only {slug} and {date} expand. Must contain {slug}.

review.description: Stage 5 three-pass review, one per run (format: Pass headings with [Tag], findings, "### Review Verdict: CLEAN|BLOCKED"). Must be relative to the repository; only {slug} and {date} expand. Must contain {slug}.

incident.description: Stage 6 to Stage 1: the intent the control bands write when a metric breaches. {date} expands to YYYY-MM-DD. Must be relative to the repository; only {slug} and {date} expand.

lesson.description: Play 14 post-mortem. {date} and {slug} expand. Must be relative to the repository; only {slug} and {date} expand.

eval.description: Plays 09/14 regression eval for a run or an incident. {slug} expands. Must be relative to the repository; only {slug} and {date} expand.

claudeMd.description: Repository memory file (Play 05). Must be relative to the repository; only {slug} and {date} expand.

reviewPolicy.description: The review policy the reviewer follows (Play 10). Must be relative to the repository; only {slug} and {date} expand.

bands.description: Statistical control bands definition (Play 13). Must be relative to the repository; only {slug} and {date} expand.

ciWorkflow.description: The CI evals workflow scaffolded from the template (Play 09). Must be relative to the repository; only {slug} and {date} expand.

managedSettings.description: Enterprise managed-settings scaffold (Play 12). It is a template to hand to your admins, not a live setting. Must be relative to the repository; only {slug} and {date} expand.

productionGate.description: The production approval gate hook script (Play 11). Must be relative to the repository; only {slug} and {date} expand.

guards.description: Deterministic tool-call guards. A guard is active only when its play is adopted and it is not listed in `disabled`. Pattern lists replace the defaults.

disabled.description: Guards switched off by hand. They stay visible, marked off, in the Guards tab.

protectedPaths.description: Globs the agent may not edit (protect-paths). The default includes .okf/** so no agent tool can change the mod's own config, ledger or run state.

testGlobs.description: Globs that identify test files; they are locked while a bug-fix protocol is active (test-lock).

planFirstExempt.description: Globs that stay editable before a plan is accepted: artifacts, docs and the mod's own files (plan-first).

secretPatterns.description: Regular expressions for secrets that must never be written (secret-leak). A source may start with (?i) for case-insensitive. The default list lives in hooks/core/guards.ts; a list given here replaces it.

name.description: Shown in the denial message; the matched secret itself is never echoed.

productionPatterns.description: Regular expressions, tested case-insensitively against Bash commands: a match is a production deploy that needs a release token or a human grant (production-gate). The default list lives in hooks/core/guards.ts; a list given here replaces it.

destructiveSql.description: Refuse DROP, TRUNCATE and DELETE FROM in Bash commands even with a release grant (destructive-sql).

protectedBranches.description: Branches the agent may not push to, force-push or merge into (separation-of-duties).

credentialPaths.description: Globs the agent may not read, edit or touch from Bash: SSH keys, cloud credentials, .env files (credential-shield). ~ is the home directory.

blockNetwork.description: Also block curl, wget and WebFetch, as the managed-settings template does (credential-shield). Off by default.

grantMinutes.description: Minutes a human release grant (/sdlc release grant) stays valid.

commands.description: Commands the proof tracker recognizes as verification runs: a Bash command that contains one of them counts, and its exit status decides pass or fail.

review.description: The three-pass review (Play 10) as the mod reads it.

nitCap.description: Most nits a review may list. More are summarized in one overflow line; a review over the cap without that line does not pass.

passes.description: The review passes, in order. Every tag must appear in a "### Pass N — Title [Tag]" heading of the review for it to count as complete.

tag.description: Tag written in brackets on every finding of the pass, e.g. Bugs.

title.description: Heading text of the pass, e.g. "Logic & Regressions".

ignorePaths.description: Globs the reviewer must not evaluate: generated files, vendor bundles, lockfiles.

bands.description: Statistical control bands (Play 13): metrics sampled on a timer, judged with Western Electric rules, tiered response.

enabled.description: Run the watcher: sample the sources and evaluate the bands.

sources.description: Metrics to sample. Each is a command run without a shell; its stdout is parsed into one number.

metric.description: Plain name, also the sample file name under .okf/bands/ and the key of the metric in bands.yaml.

argv.description: The command and its arguments, no shell.

parse.description: "number": stdout is a number. "json:a.b.0.c": the number at that path of the JSON on stdout.

higherIsWorse.description: true: a rising value is worse (failure rate). false: a falling value is worse (throughput).

window.description: Rolling window in samples for the mean and standard deviation. At least 8, the samples needed before a band is judged.

tier3.description: What a 3-sigma breach does. propose: write a proposal a person approves (the mod never acts alone). runbook: run `runbook` once a person approves.

runbook.description: Commands run after a person approves a 3-sigma breach when tier3 is "runbook".

openPaneOnStart.description: Open the Loop pane when a session starts (wide terminals only).

showBand.description: Show the one-line band above the prompt while a run exists.

policySkills.description: Globs of policy skills and docs the design stage must load (Plays 02 and 06).
